listing.title: Borzoi Russian Wolfhound Bust, Cold Cast Bronze Sculpture, Small dog bust, Home and Office Decor, Dog Trophy, Dog Memorial
listing.description:
A small dog bust statuette

- The plaques are made of cold cast bronze which allows us to keep the look and durability of bronze while reducing the price and weight of a figurine. 
- The sculpture is meant to be glued on even surface.
- You can check dimensions in the attached photo.
- The statues are life-like, made by hand with a great attention to detail and distinctive features of a dog.
- A perfect addition to a memorial place of your dog.
- Each piece is individually hand-finished by artisans. 

Our high-class art deco plaques are made by hand by the best Polish artist. They are characterized by remarkable precision of workmanship and attention to details, which is visible in the accuracy of representation of distinctive features of the breed. To produce our busts, we use cold cast bronze which allows us to keep the look and durability of bronze and at the same time to reduce the price and weight of a figurine. 
Our plaques will certainly bring happiness to the owners and admirers of dogs. They will make a beautiful home and office decoration. Our figurines can serve also as a dog show trophy or a pet memorial gift.

Materials: Our statues are made from cold cast bronze. This technique uses a mixture of bronze powder with epoxy resin which is poured into a silicone mold. A cast created with this technique looks like a regular bronze statue and is equally cold to touch. Cold cast bronze products are equally valuable artwise as regular bronze statuettes, but are cheaper. The costs of shipping are also lower, which is particularly beneficial in terms of orders sent outside of Europe.

The plaque is appropriate to keep it outside, but it can change color due to atmospheric conditions.
